subject: On‑Prem packaging, escrow & observability addon — SLA fallback options
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novumhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, contracts@novumhealth.com
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On‑prem packaging questions + escrow / SLA fallback

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — team really liked the latency profile and the private control plane. A couple of follow ups from procurement/legal as we try to sketch a preliminary commercial: 

- Platform fee vs per-node license: Novum prefers to understand a blended monthly fee for pilot (6 months) and breakpoints if we convert to a 24‑month commit.
- Observability add‑on: can you share costs for the observability retention addon (90d vs 365d) and whether that sits under the platform fee or a separate invoice line?
- Escrow / source‑access for airgapped deploy: legal asked if Redwood provides an escrow deposit construct or a technical runbook in the event of vendor insolvency.
- SLA fallback: if the private deployment fails during pilot (eg: hardware outage / latency regressions), what's the standard fallback — hosted fallover, credits, or paid SRE assistance?

We'd like a short note we can share internally (procurement + security) by EOD Friday. Attaching the Novum term sheet draft (light edits).

Appreciate a clear breakdown so we can move to a commercial review.

Best,
Elaine
Director, IT Sourcing
Novum Health

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, contracts@novumhealth.com

Subject: Re: On‑prem packaging questions + escrow / SLA fallback

Hi Elaine — thanks, and glad the demo was useful. Summary below (high level) and attaching a compact pricing workbook for the observability options. I'll follow up with our legal counterpart for the escrow outline.

1) Pilot pricing (6 months) — suggested structure
- Monthly platform fee (pilot): €12,000/month (includes control plane, 8 concurrent inference workers, standard KV caching).
- Operator licenses (optional): €1,500/month per operator seat if you want dedicated on‑site operator access (recommended for airgapped installs).
- If you convert to a 24‑month commit within pilot: platform fee amortized to €9,000/month and we include 10% discount on operator licenses.

2) Observability retention add‑on
- 90d retention: flat €1,800/month
- 365d retention: flat €4,500/month
- Observability is invoiced separately (adds as a line item) but can be bundled into the platform fee for committed deals (we can amortize at negotiation).

3) Escrow / runbook
- We provide a lightweight technical runbook + deployment artifacts under NDA (no full source escrow currently).
- For enterprise deals we offer an escrow play (third‑party escrow of deployment artifacts + limited compiled binaries) — requires standalone addendum and one‑time escrow fee (typical: €25k).

4) SLA fallback options
- Hosted fallover: we can permit temporary hosted routing for up to 14 days with no additional platform fee (data processed on hosted cluster is metered at standard hosted rates).
- Paid SRE assistance: 40 hours of remote SRE support included for pilot; additional on‑site SRE at standard rates (€2,000/day).
- Service credits: for sustained platform unavailability > 4 hours in a 30‑day window, we offer pro‑rata credits up to 10% of monthly platform fee (applies to Dedicated/Private only with the SLA addendum).

Next steps: if this aligns, I'll loop in our legal (Irene Choi) and pricing (Marissa) to firm up numbers and prepare an addendum.

Best,
Sofia
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Subject: FW: Novum Health — pilot pricing ask (need discount guidance)

Marissa / Irene — forwarding Elaine's note from Novum Health. Highlights: EU health system, pilot (6m), likely to convert to 24m if latency and SOC‑reporting looks good. Procurement pushing for: lower pilot platform fee, observability bundled, and firm escrow language.

Questions for pricing/legal:
- Can we offer a one‑time 15% pilot discount on the platform fee if they commit to a 24‑month conversion within pilot? Any red flags in legal for escrow outline?
- Should we bundle observability 90d for free during pilot vs invoicing separately? (My instinct: include 90d free, and charge for 365d).

Aiming to send a revised note back to Elaine by Friday EOD.

—Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Novum Health — pilot pricing ask (need discount guidance)

Sofia — quick thoughts from pricing/legal POV:

- Pilot discount: we can do 12% one‑time pilot discount on platform fee tied to an executed 24m conversion LOI within the pilot window. 15% is slightly aggressive for a seed pilot but not impossible with approvals. Suggest we position 12% as standard, and hold 3% as a negotiable concession if they ask for escrow fee offset.

- Observability: agree to include 90d free for pilot (value shows value and reduces fricción). Charge for 365d at list price. Important to mark observability as billable add‑on in the MSA so it can be toggled post‑pilot.

- Escrow: legal (Irene) — we should avoid full source escrow. Offer: technical runbook + third‑party escrow of compiled artifacts behind an addendum. Recommend a one‑time escrow fee of €20k for EU customers (slightly lower than standard due to non‑strategic nature).

- SLA fallback: support the hosted fallover for up to 14 days. For credits, keep pro‑rata up to 8% for pilot deals (save the 10% for committed Dedicated deals).

If Irene signs off, I'll draft a compact commercial note and a one‑page escrows addendum the client can review.

—Marissa

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Hi all,

Following internal review, here's a concise commercial package Novum can share with procurement/legal: 

- Pilot (6 months):
  • Platform fee: €10,560/month (12% pilot discount applied) — includes control plane, 8 inference workers, standard caching.
  • Observability: 90d retention included at no charge during pilot. 365d available at €4,500/month post‑pilot.
  • Operator license: €1,350/month per operator (10% pilot operator discount).
  • Escrow: one‑time fee €20,000 for third‑party compiled artifact escrow + runbook under NDA.
  • SLA fallback: hosted fallover allowed up to 14 days; included 40h remote SRE support during pilot. For outages >4 hours, client eligible for pro‑rata credit up to 8% of monthly platform fee.

I attach a short escrow addendum draft and the observability workbook. If you approve, Sofia, we can send to Elaine with an explicit call to action: sign LOI to lock pilot discount and schedule kickoff.

Regards,
